discovered_false_green.what: Dashboard G6/G7/G9 'honest-green' DONE condition was a FALSE-GREEN. index.html loaded card traces via fetch() of relative paths. Chrome/Safari block fetch() under the file:// origin (opaque/null origin → CORS). The user opened apps/pdf-extractor/dashboard/index.html by DOUBLE-CLICKING it (file://) and saw EVERY card as NOT-RUN — the user's real acceptance path was broken.
discovered_false_green.why_old_verification_was_blind: The original G9 Playwright contract (commit 3e7f476c) served the page over http://localhost:9999. Over http://, fetch() of relative paths works — so the old contract reported PASS. It NEVER tested the user's actual file:// double-click path, which was the only path that mattered. http-only verification is a false-green generator for a file:// deliverable.
discovered_false_green.user_report: "i dont see finish" — user double-clicked index.html, saw all-NOT-RUN, correctly rejected the close.
discovered_false_green.original_close_record: commit 3e840688 (decisionMatrix.populatedInCommit) + closure signal docs/signals/po-pdf-extractor-pilot-DONE-20260524T114403Z.json §final_done_conditions.b_dashboard_honest_green='CONFIRMED' — that CONFIRMED was earned over http only, hence false-green for the file:// acceptance condition.

No fetch(). Renders correctly when double-clicked, zero network. Files: dashboard/index.html, dashboard/traces.js (new sidecar), sandbox/gen_traces_js.py (new), sandbox/rerun.sh.

L8 (pdf-extractor terminal): a frozen-goal NO ruling is REOPENABLE when its recorded reopen_condition is met by a proper architect+QA clearance — not by fiat. G5 held HONESTLY at 11/12 from 10:14Z until 1954c landed (architect 82aec082 + QA gate), then flipped YES at 11:44Z. The behavioral RCA freeze was lifted by clearance, never bypassed.

L9 (pdf-extractor dashboard FALSE-GREEN, post-close reopen): a dashboard 'honest-green' goal MUST be verified under the USER's actual open path (file:// double-click), NEVER only via a convenience HTTP server. http-only verification is a false-green generator: fetch() of relative paths works over http but is CORS-blocked at the file:// null origin, so an http-served Playwright contract reports PASS while the double-clicked page shows all-NOT-RUN. The pdf-extractor G9 contract (3e7f476c) shipped this exact false-green; the user caught it ('i dont see finish'). Fix: load traces via <script src="traces.js"> read synchronously from window.__TRACES (a9fdf056), and make file:// the PRIMARY tested path in the trust contract (9ff5dba3). SECONDARY lesson: an honest-red proof injected into a file the page no longer reads is itself a false-green — assert the honesty proof targets the SAME artifact the page actually loads. FLEET MANDATE: future scale pilots inheriting this dashboard pattern MUST test file:// as the primary trust-contract path.
